description: Keeps the action pins current (#326), in the workflows and in the composite actions under .github/actions: each action stays pinned to a commit SHA, with its release as a trailing comment. The one exception is the bug agent's shared workflow, which a rule below leaves at automation's `master` (#849).
Also keeps the npm packages the `release` job installs from tool/release/package.json (#419) current, and its lockfile with them, as one group so semantic-release and its plugins move together.

That job runs these packages with a token that can push to master, so an npm update waits until its release is three days old: a hijacked release is usually caught and pulled within that window. tool/release/.npmrc holds transitive versions to the same age when the lockfile is regenerated.
Only the github-actions and npm managers are enabled, and only .github and tool/release are read. Nothing else in this repository is updated by Renovate.

packageRules.description: The bug agent's shared workflow is called at automation's `master`, unpinned (#849). A pin would freeze the workflow's jobs, their permissions and which steps receive the secrets, but not the prompts and scripts it reads from `master` whatever ref the caller names, which receive the API key and the app's short-lived token.
